_comment: Guildhaven -- a hand-authored (Noggit) map a friend made, map id 725, added to the realm through the same
MapForge build as Royale (901) and Crucible (902). The terrain is NOT generated: terrain/external.py stages
the friend's own guildhaven.wdt/.wdl/_18_18.adt and writes the terrain_manifest.json this config is built
against. build-guildhaven.sh wires the two together.
map id 725: the next free id above stock's 724 in the FRIEND's Map.dbc. The realm has customs at 740
(Emberwing Hollow), 901 and 902, and HD packs may have claimed ids; run the same id-conflict check royale/
crucible describe (forge_check.py against the realm's pulled DBCs, and package.py build --server-sql) before
install. If 725 is taken, change map.id here and re-run -- nothing else depends on the number.
instance_type 0 (a normal open-world continent), exactly as the friend built it: walkable, GM .tele works
(.go xyz <x> <y> <z> 725). The map's 722 models and 42 WMOs are ALL stock Blizzard paths (verified), so any
3.3.5a client already has the art; package.py doctor / resolve-assets on the VPS re-checks against the real
client and names anything missing.
zone 5230 (The Fire-Cult range 5220-5223 is Crucible's, Royale owns 5200-5217): the friend's ADT marks every
MCNK area id 0, so the map had no zone name or music. The forge sets Map.areaTableID to this zone id (the
map-wide default area), which gives the whole map a name and music without re-editing the ADT. Verify 5230 is
free and pick zone.template's id with forge_check.py --areas on the VPS, same as crucible.
zone.template 12 (Elwynn Forest): a calm daytime outdoor ambience and music, a reasonable default for a human/
forest build (guild houses, farms, moonwells). Change the id if a different mood suits; clear_flags drops the
rule-changing bits (duels, rest, sanctuary, cities, PvP, INSIDE) so the zone inherits nothing stray.
light null: an expansion-0 outdoor map with no Light row uses the client's default daylight (not black, unlike
a sealed instance -- that is why Crucible needed params_from_map and this does not). A custom sky can be added
later with light.params_from_map once forge_check lists a map whose default light suits.
archives.map patch-O.MPQ: a free letter. NOT patch-G (G is an HD optional-pack letter), not K (Crucible) or Q
(Royale). The Map.dbc row itself is placed by package.py's plan into whichever realm archive wins per pack
combination (so 901/902/HD/stock are kept and 725 still wins); this letter only carries the terrain and the
no-realm-patch copy, and only has to beat the stock locale archives. Verify patch-O is absent from the
launcher before deploying.
corpse_map -1: release-to-graveyard behaviour is server-side and not set here.

archives._comment: patch-O.MPQ carries only Guildhaven's terrain and the stock-combo DBC copy; the realm's own archives are the merge targets package.py's plan picks. Verify O is free on the launcher first.
